content: Breath sounds are the distinct auditory phenomena detected during the auscultation of the respiratory system using a stethoscope. In this context, the term adventitious is used to describe sounds that are heard in addition to the normal sounds of inspiration and expiration. A novel technology known as vibration response imaging is currently being studied. This technology generates dynamic images of the lungs by measuring the vibration energy produced within the lungs. This method is non-invasive and does not involve exposure to radiation.
